description: Exactly one call to action, fully qualified to www.canvasintelligence.com with all three UTM parameters, and never a link shortener.

input.proof_point: a Synapse to Fabric migration completed without breaking a single downstream dashboard

rubric.criterion: Single fully qualified CTA with UTM parameters
rubric.condition: The post body contains exactly 1 URL; it starts with https://www.canvasintelligence.com/ and contains utm_source=, utm_medium= and utm_campaign=.
The output contains zero occurrences of any of: bit.ly, lnkd.in, tinyurl.com, ow.ly, buff.ly.
The output contains the literal substring utm_campaign=fabric-production-proof, matching the campaign supplied in the input.

notes: Anchored to prompt.md hard rule 4. Mirrors the deterministic url-utm and link-shortener rules in services/registry/safety_suite.py.
